title: Macro Defect Inspection - Micro-cracks Detection on ICOS T3/T7
subtitle: Pre-Diffusion Quality Validation for 22nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Klaus Weber

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ICOS T3/T7 system to detect and classify Micro-cracks defects during pre-diffusion inspection at the 22nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Micro-cracks defects that are critical to yield at the 22nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ICOS T3/T7 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ICOS T3/T7
- Inspection Type: Macro Defect Inspection
- Target Defect: Micro-cracks
- Process Step: Pre-Diffusion
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 22nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all ICOS T3/T7 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for pre-diffusion monitoring in the 22nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ICOS T3/T7
Software Version: v11.7.683
Recipe: MACRO_DEFECT_INSPECTION_22nm_PRE_DIFFUSION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (89 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ICOS T3/T7 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Macro Defect Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Micro-cracks defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 22nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 70 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 93% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.3% for Macro Defect Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-05-02
Wafers Tested: 6
Total Defects Found: 4135
Defect Density: 1316.21 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 3.0%
Capture Rate: 93.7%
Test Duration: 445 minutes
System Uptime: 96.5%

Result Classification: FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ICOS T3/T7 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Micro-cracks at the 22nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Re-tune detection algorithm thresholds for Micro-cracks at 22nm node.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Escalate to R&D for algorithm enhancement if re-tuning does not resolve sensitivity gap.
